what: The editor's bundled examples. The ticket is the d1-3B model card's text example; the incident note and the review are invented for this app (no real people, companies or products); the photo example is the card's picture question on a Pexels photo (fixtures/media_sources.json).

examples.title: Ticket
examples.state: I was charged twice this month, please refund one of them.

refund.instructions: Is the customer asking for a refund?

examples.title: Incident
examples.state: Incident note. At 02:10 the checkout page began returning errors for about one in five customers. The on-call engineer rolled back the evening release at 02:35 and the errors stopped. No payment was taken twice. The release had set the payment service timeout too low; a test for that setting will run before the next release.

criteria.release: A software release or a setting
criteria.provider: A problem at an outside provider

criteria.true: Customers saw errors or lost money

criteria: Major: some customers affected for under an hour
Critical: a long outage or lost data

examples.title: Review
examples.state: Review of wireless headphones, by a verified buyer. The sound is clear and the battery lasts all week. After two months the ear cushions started to peel, and support asked me to pay the shipping for a replacement. Good headphones, poor follow-up.

complaint.instructions: What is the reviewer's main complaint?

sound.instructions: Does the reviewer praise the sound?

feeling.instructions: How does the reviewer feel overall?
